posts.trend: Festive hiring surge puts workforce planning, employee burnout in focus
posts.context: Companies use the cultural cover of festivals to mask chronic understaffing and force extreme overtime.
posts.angle: A festive surge is just corporate understaffing dressed up in ethnic wear.
slides: We are looking for a Festive Warrior who thrives under pressure.

Must think of 14-hour days as festive cheer.
Must treat chest pain as passion.
Must accept a dry fruit box as variable pay.
Must not have plans for Diwali.

The shifts are twelve hours.

Your manager's out-of-office is already active.
posts.caption: Happy holidays to the leadership team. ✨
posts.rank_verdict: The hook violates the strict second-person rule by adopting a first-person corporate 'We' perspective.
